target_policy.name: nearest-reference-segment-with-motion-orientation-v1
target_policy.description: Project each GPS observation onto every distinct canonical directed reference-route segment; minimise distance squared plus 32m^2 times reliable signed heading mismatch. Motion uses at most +/-3 rows and never crosses a >20s local dropout. Route data is used ONLY to create labels or score completed predictions, never features.
target_policy.limitations: No per-observation labels were supplied. Intersections, stops, nearby parallel roads, repeated traversals and route defects can make these proxy labels uncertain; these metrics are not independently verified GPS ground truth. The geometry-derived target favours geometric predictors.

observation_metrics.categorical_log_loss_policy: Normalize binary positive probabilities within each observation; absent target receives zero mass and finite log score uses floor1e-7. This is an emission log score, not a calibration claim. Misses are included in the unconditional score.

student_observation_metrics.continuity_definition: Adjacent available observation assignments are continuous iff same canonical edge OR head(previous)==tail(current); no routed connectors. Empty assignments count discontinuous. Includes observed time gaps; on downsampled CV this would not imply every intervening road was predicted.

bayesian.method: GaussianProcessRegressor Matern-5/2 surrogate + analytic expected improvement
bayesian.objective: maximize out-of-fold equal-trip mean observation top1 proxy accuracy; fixed 3/5-fold GroupKFold on all 80 TRAIN trips
bayesian.selection_data: TRAIN only; student_test metrics not loaded during HPO
